subject: Money
title: The Sunk Cost Trap
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Sunk Cost Trap usable.

hook.text: You paid $200 for concert tickets. It's raining. You're sick. You go anyway because you already paid.

buildup.text: Sunk costs are spent money you can't recover. Rationally, they shouldn't affect future decisions.

discovery.text: But we hate wasting money more than we value our time. We throw good hours after bad dollars.

twist.text: Companies know this. Gym memberships, subscriptions, and pre-orders all exploit the sunk cost trap.

climax.text: The rational choice: ignore what you've already spent. Decide based only on future value.

punchline.text: Spent money is gone. Stop chasing it.

quiz.question: Why do people attend events they no longer want to go to?
